preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 200, inclusive.
The number of nodes N and the number of special nodes K are between 1 and 200000, inclusive.
The node a is between 1 and N, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= f_i <= N for each valid i
preconditions.description: Each special node f_i is between 1 and N, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: f_i != f_j for each valid i and j such that i != j
1 <= u_i, v_i <= N for each valid i
preconditions.description: Each edge u_i and v_i is between 1 and N, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: The graph described on the input is a tree
preconditions.description: The input graph is a tree.

preconditions.expression: The sum of N over all test cases does not exceed 400000
preconditions.description: The total number of nodes across all test cases does not exceed 400000.

postconditions.expression: The first line of the output contains N space-separated integers
postconditions.description: The first line of the output contains N space-separated integers representing the maximum value of d(a,u)-d(b,u) for each node b.

postconditions.expression: The second line of the output contains N space-separated integers
postconditions.description: The second line of the output contains N space-separated integers representing the special node u for which the maximum value of d(a,u)-d(b,u) is attained for each node b.
